magic.task.flight.0: Afterburn, Magic. You're cleared into the corridor. No tasking, no threats. Fly the gates, stay above the ground, and bring the aeroplane back.
magic.task.flight.1: Magic copies you airborne. The sky's yours. Gates are for the score, the crystal is for the scenery. Keep it out of the rocks.
magic.task.war.0: Afterburn, Magic. Tasking: sweep the corridor. Five groups committed on you. Splash everything airborne, then I'll bring you home. Weapons free.
magic.task.war.1: Magic. Picture: five waves inbound on your corridor, first group twenty miles. Kill them all, then RTB. You are cleared hot.
magic.daily.0: Afterburn, Magic. Daily run. Same corridor as everyone else today. Your ghost is already airborne. Beat her.
magic.train.open.0: Afterburn, Magic. First flight. Hook has you from the back seat. Do what he says, one thing at a time, and you'll be fine.
magic.wave.1.0: Magic, picture. Group one, three bandits, twelve o'clock, twenty miles, low. They'll stay in front of you. Commit.
magic.wave.2.0: Magic, new picture. Group two, four bandits, twelve o'clock. Watch it: this bunch will drop back onto your six. Commit.
magic.wave.3.0: Magic. Group three, five bandits on the nose, closing. One of them is hot, head-on. Commit.
magic.wave.4.0: Magic. Group four, six bandits. Expect them behind you. Use the reversal. Commit.
magic.wave.5.0: Magic. Group five, seven bandits, everything they have. Clean them up and I'll bring you home.
magic.wave.last.0: Magic. Last group. Everything they have left is committed on you. Splash them and I'll bring you home.
magic.wave.last.1: Magic. Final group inbound. Finish this and you're done for the day.
magic.wave.clear.0: Magic. Picture clean. Stand by, next group's on the way.
magic.wave.clear.1: Clean. Take a breath. I'm working the next group.
magic.wave.clear.2: Magic copies the wave. Picture's clean for now. Stay sharp.
magic.home.0: Magic. Picture clean, no further tasking. RTB. Weapons safe.
magic.home.1: Magic. That's all of them. Come home. Good work.
magic.rtb.base.0: Magic. Vector home plate, dead ahead, ten miles. Descend at your discretion, gear down inside two miles. You're cleared to land.
magic.rtb.base.1: Magic. The strip is on your nose, ten miles. Line up early, get the gear down, and ease it on.
magic.rtb.ship.0: Magic. Mother is dead ahead, ten miles. Call the ball at three quarters of a mile and fly it to the deck. Cleared for the approach.
magic.rtb.ship.1: Magic. Ship's on your nose. Hook down, gear down, fly the ball. Cleared to land.
magic.bingo.0: Afterburn, Magic. You're bingo fuel. Knock it off and come home now.
magic.missed.0: Magic. Go around, climb straight ahead. I'll set you up again.
magic.missed.1: Magic copies the go-around. No harm done. Come back round.
magic.landed.0: Magic. Welcome home. Good work out there.
magic.landed.1: Magic copies you down. Nice job, Afterburn.
magic.trap.0: Magic copies you aboard. Well done.
magic.fail.0: Afterburn, Magic. That's a scrub. Come home.
magic.fail.1: Magic. Mission's over. Bring the aeroplane back.
magic.targets.done.0: Magic. All targets destroyed. Objective complete. Egress and stand by for the CAP.
magic.targets.done.1: Magic copies, all targets down. That's the objective. Now get out of there.
magic.two.lost.0: Magic copies Two is down. No chute. I'm sorry.
magic.two.lost.1: Magic. Two's off the scope. Continue if you can.
magic.sam.0: Magic. SAM site ahead of you. It will shoot first. Get low, or get past it.
magic.sam.1: Afterburn, Magic. Threat radar ahead, on the ground. Stay in the folds.
magic.weather.0: Magic. Lost your track in the weather. Call me when you're clear.
magic.weather.1: Magic has no contact. You're in the cloud. Nobody can see you.
magic.m1.0: Afterburn, Magic. First light. Three groups are working the valley at low level. Your orders: take Two with you, splash all three groups, keep Two alive, then bring both jets home to the strip. Weapons free.
magic.m2.0: Afterburn, Magic. Shelf strike. Four SAM sites on the terraces, and they will shoot first. Orders: get under their radar in the folds, put bombs on all four, then fight your way out through the CAP. Home plate is the strip.
magic.m3.0: Afterburn, Magic. Mother is on the mirror sea with two groups inbound on her. Orders: splash both groups, then recover aboard. Fly the ball. The water is not an option.
magic.m4.0: Afterburn, Magic. Canyon escort. Two is hurt and has to go through the canyon on the deck. Four groups will try to finish him. Orders: stay on his wing, take the shots he can't, and get him out the far end. He does not go down.
magic.m5.0: Afterburn, Magic. Graveyard. Three radar domes in the monoliths are cueing the interceptors. Orders: kill the domes, weather the head-on passes, then recover aboard Mother on the sea beyond.
magic.m6.0: Afterburn, Magic. Midnight. Full moon and a solid deck. Three groups above the tops. Orders: splash them, then a night recovery down through the deck to Mother. Trust the ball, not your eyes.
magic.enter.valley.0: Magic. You're entering the valley. Forests and gates. Low and slow works here.
magic.enter.shelf.0: Magic. Entering the shelf. Terraces, and threat radar on them. Stay in the folds.
magic.enter.canyon.0: Magic. Canyon ahead. Expect wind shear between the walls. Below the rim is worth points, if you keep it off the walls.
magic.enter.sea.0: Magic. Entering the mirror sea. Flat water, thermals down low. Skim it if you want the bonus.
magic.enter.spires.0: Magic. Spire forest. Crystal on the corridor. Chain them with the gun if you can, and don't fly into one.
magic.enter.ridge.0: Magic. The ridge. Lift on the face, sink on the back, and a pass at the top. Cross it low for the bonus.
magic.enter.graveyard.0: Magic. Entering the graveyard. Monoliths, radar domes, and the interceptor nest. Head-on passes from here.
magic.enter.reach.0: Magic. The reach. High country and the long intercepts. Watch the islands.
takeoff.flight.0: Throttle's yours. Let's go scare some scenery.
takeoff.flight.1: Alright, hotshot. Wheels up, and try not to hit the only mountain out here.
takeoff.flight.2: Runway's clear, sky's clear. Everything else is your problem.
takeoff.war.0: Cleared hot. They already know we're coming, so let's not disappoint them.
takeoff.war.1: Wheels up, guns hot. Somebody out there wants a fight. Let's give 'em one.
takeoff.war.2: Rolling. Bandits inbound. Coffee's gonna have to wait.
foxtwo.1: Fox two. That one's got his name on it.
hit.wing.0: Left wing took one. Roll's gonna feel like wet cardboard.
hit.wing.1: Wing's hit. She rolls like a bathtub now. Adjust.
hit.engine.0: Engine's hit. We're down on thrust. Stop wishing, start flying.
hit.engine.1: Took one in the engine. She's tired. Nurse it.
hit.hyd.0: Hydraulics. She's heavy on the stick. Muscle it.
hit.hyd.1: Lost hydraulics. Everything's gonna feel like it's underwater.
hit.0: We're hit! Felt that one in my teeth.
hit.1: Taking hits! Quit sightseeing and move!
hit.2: That one hurt. Get us out of his sights.
hit.3: Hit! Don't fly straight, he'll do it again.
critical.0: Critical. One more and we're a lawn dart. Get it home.
critical.1: We're falling apart out here. One more hit and that's the ballgame.
splash.1.2: That's one. Try not to get cocky.
splash.2.2: Splash two. Somebody's having a bad day, and it ain't us.
splash.3.0: Splash three. You're getting good at this.
splash.3.1: Three. I'm starting to enjoy myself.
splash.4.0: Splash four. Okay, now you're showing off.
splash.4.1: Four. Leave some for the rest of the squadron.
splash.5.0: Splash five. I'm running out of jokes.
splash.5.1: That's five. You want a medal or a bigger gun?
splash.6.0: Splash six. I'm gonna need a bigger scoreboard.
splash.6.1: Six. Their recruiter's gonna have a busy week.
splash.7.0: Splash seven. Are you even trying anymore?
splash.7.1: Seven. I'll stop counting, you keep shooting.
splash.8.0: Splash eight. Alright, I'm impressed. Don't let it go to your head.
splash.8.1: Eight. Okay, we're done here. Nobody's left.
wave.clear.0: Picture's clean. Breathe. There's more coming.
wave.clear.1: Sky's clear. Take five seconds. That's all you get.
wave.clear.2: That's the wave. Check your six, reload your nerve.
wave.home.0: Picture's clean. That's the lot. Take us home.
wave.home.1: That was all of them. Let's go find something to land on.
wave.home.2: Sky's empty. Home, and I'm buying.
rtb.ship.0: Return to the ship. Line up, call the ball, and don't embarrass me.
rtb.ship.1: Ship's ahead. Fly the ball, catch a wire, and we'll pretend it was smooth.
rtb.base.0: Return to base. Runway's ahead. Ease it down, hero.
rtb.base.1: Home plate's dead ahead. Gear down, nose up, no heroics.
sam.0: SAM launch! Break, flare, and stop admiring it!
sam.1: Missile off the ground! Flares, now! Beam it!
sam.2: SAM! Break hard, hit the flares, go!
missile.2: Missile in the air! Notch it or flare it, but do something!
defeat.flare.1: Missile went for the flare. Dumb rocket.
defeat.flare.2: Decoyed. That's why we carry those.
defeat.notch.1: It lost us. That's how you notch a missile.
defeat.cloud.0: It lost us in the weather. Told you I like clouds.
defeat.cloud.1: Missile's blind in this soup. Stay in it a second.
kill.radar.1: Radar's gone. Nobody's watching us anymore.
kill.sam.0: Site destroyed. That's how you drop a bomb.
kill.sam.1: SAM site's a crater. Good bombs.
kill.depot.1: That depot's gonna burn all week.
targets.done.0: All targets down. Egress, before somebody starts counting.
targets.done.1: That's every target. Let's leave before they get organized.
two.lost.0: Two's going in. No chute. Damn it.
two.lost.1: We lost Two. Get angry later. Fly now.
eclipse.0: The sun's going out. Not our problem yet.
eclipse.1: Eclipse. Don't look at it, look at the ground.
moon.red.0: That moon's red. I don't love that.
moon.0: Look at that moon. Now look at the road.
moon.1: Big moon tonight. Nice night for it.
moon.2: Full moon over the deck. Enjoy it for one second, then fly.
bingo.0: Bingo fuel. Head for the deck, unless you enjoy gliding.
bingo.1: We're bingo. Home, now. Gliders don't get paid.
engineout.0: Engine's out. Congratulations, we're a glider.
engineout.1: Flameout. Okay. Trade height for speed and find something flat.
stall.0: Stall! Nose down, get the speed back!
stall.1: She's stalling! Unload, nose down, now!
land.greased.0: Greased it. I didn't even feel that. Welcome home.
land.down.0: Wheels down. Welcome home. I've had worse.
land.down.1: We're down. Any landing you walk away from, right?
land.down.2: Welcome home. Nobody tell the maintenance chief.
laser.0: Laser's online. Point it at something you don't like.
laser.1: We've got the laser. Go ruin somebody's afternoon.
winchester.0: Winchester. Guns are empty. Get creative.
winchester.1: We're out of bullets. Missiles or harsh language, your call.
bolter.0: Bolter, bolter! Power, go around, and stop looking at me.
bolter.1: Missed the wires. Power up, go around, try again.
trap.ok3.0: Three wire. OK pass. Welcome aboard, ace.
trap.ok3.1: Three wire. That's the one. Nice trap.
trap.0: Trap. Welcome aboard. A wire's a wire.
trap.1: We caught one. Not pretty, but we're aboard.
missed.0: Missed approach. Go around. No shame in it. Some shame.
missed.1: Go around. Runway's not going anywhere.
gear.0: Gear! Check your gear, unless you want a belly ride.
gear.1: Gear's up! Put it down before the runway does it for you!
rim.0: Below the rim. Nice. Now don't hit it.
rim.1: Under the rim. Walls on both sides, hands steady.
six.1: He's on our six! Break now!
six.2: Behind us! Break right, break right!
six.3: Bandit's on our tail! Don't fly straight!
weather.0: In the weather. They've lost us. Shh.
weather.1: We're in the clouds. Nobody can see us. Don't ruin it.
mission.fail.0: Mission failed. We'll talk about it on the ground.
mission.fail.1: That's a scrub. Debrief's gonna be a long one.
enter.valley.0: Entering the valley. The trees don't move. You do.
enter.valley.1: Valley. Forests, gates, and a whole lot of nothing to hit but the ground.
enter.shelf.0: Entering the shelf. Watch the terraces, they bite.
enter.shelf.1: The shelf. Terraces and SAM sites. Stay in the folds.
enter.canyon.0: Entering the canyon. Walls on both sides and wind in between.
enter.canyon.1: Canyon. The wind's gonna shove us around in here. Fly it, don't fight it.
enter.sea.0: Entering the mirror sea. Don't stare at your reflection.
enter.sea.1: The sea. Flat, wide, and shiny. Skim it if you're feeling brave.
enter.spires.0: Entering the spire forest. Crystal everywhere. Try not to become a windshield.
enter.spires.1: Spires. Big, pretty, and they don't move. Don't test that.
enter.ridge.0: Entering the ridge. There's a pass up ahead. Take it low if you're brave.
enter.ridge.1: The ridge. Lift on the face, sink on the back. Mind the pass.
enter.graveyard.0: Entering the graveyard. Monoliths, domes, and things that don't like us.
enter.graveyard.1: Graveyard. If it's tall and dark, it's a rock. If it's shooting, it's not.
enter.reach.0: Entering the reach. Long way down from here.
enter.reach.1: The reach. High country. Watch the islands, they hang around.
train.0.0: Throttle up. Rotate when she's ready. She'll tell you. Once we're up, the mouse is the stick: middle is level, push it where you want to go.
train.1.0: Pull up. Climb through six hundred. Sky's that way.
train.2.0: Now turn. Push the stick out to the side and lean into it.
train.3.0: Light the burner. Hold space and enjoy the push.
train.4.0: Roll it. Q or E. Don't overthink it.
train.5.0: Airbrake. Hold shift and feel it bite.
train.6.0: Thread a gate. Through the ring, not into it.
train.7.0: Good. Now bring it home. Line up on the runway, ease it down, and flare.
m1.0: First light. Three waves in the valley. Keep Two alive, then land it.
m2.0: Shelf strike. Four SAM sites on the terraces. Get low, bomb 'em, get out.
m3.0: Mirror. Two waves are coming for the carrier. Splash 'em, then trap aboard.
m4.0: Canyon escort. Two's hurt. Stay on his wing through the canyon, no matter what.
m5.0: Graveyard. Three radar domes in the monoliths. Kill 'em, then find the ship.
m6.0: Midnight. Three waves above the deck, then a night trap. Trust the ball.
copy.0: Copy, Magic. You heard the lady.
copy.1: Copy all. Let's go earn it.
copy.2: Roger, Magic. Wasn't gonna do anything else anyway.
copy.3: Copy. Hook's got the back seat, you've got the stick. Don't mix 'em up.
commit.1: Got 'em on the scope. Let's go say hi.
commit.2: Contact. Burner if you want 'em close, brake if you want 'em gone.
radiocheck.0: Loud and clear, Magic. Bored, but clear.
radiocheck.1: Five by five. Miss us already?
radiocheck.2: Read you, Magic. Still airborne, still handsome.
rtb.copy.0: Copy home plate. Get us on the ground in one piece.
rtb.copy.1: Roger, heading home. Nose up, gear down, no heroics.
rtb.copy.2: Copy. Land it like you mean it.
merge.0: He's turning in behind us! Merge! Watch your six!
merge.1: Passed us and he's coming round. He'll be on our tail in a second.
merge.2: Merge! He's swinging onto our six. Don't fly straight.
overshoot.0: He overshot! He's in front of us, take the shot!
overshoot.1: There he goes, right past us. Gun him, gun him!
overshoot.2: Overshoot! He's on the nose. Don't waste it.
cobra.0: Cobra! Hang on and watch him go by!
cobra.1: Nose up, everything stops. Here he comes past.
splits.1: Inverted and pulling. Ground's coming up, so pull.
immelmann.0: Over the top. World's turning round. There he is, on the nose.
immelmann.1: Immelmann. What was behind us is in front now. Shoot it.
streak.0: Five gates straight. You're showing off and I'm here for it.
streak.1: That's a streak. Don't blink now.
streak.2: Five in a row. Somebody's been practicing.
knife.0: Knife edge through the ring. Fancy.
knife.1: Sideways through a gate. Somebody's feeling good.
nearmiss.0: That was close! Quit it. Actually, don't.
nearmiss.1: Missed it by a coat of paint. Again!
treetop.0: Treetops. Lower. No, wait, that's low enough.
treetop.1: In the trees. I can smell the pine from here.
arch.0: Under the arch! Nobody saw that but me.
arch.1: Through the arch. I'd clap if I wasn't holding on.
two.hit.crit.0: Two's hit! I'm in trouble here!
two.hit.crit.1: Two's hurt bad! I can't take another one!
two.hit.1: Took one. I'm okay. Keep going.
two.tally.1: Two's got eyes on. Bandit, dead ahead.
two.wing.3: Still here. Still bored. Find me something to shoot.
two.rtb.0: Two's with you. Take us home.
two.rtb.1: Two copies home plate. Right behind you, lead.
